# 🤝 Sorayunara & C/C++ Bi-Directional Interoperability
**Standard**: ANSI C99 / ISO C++17 Compatible Header Generation

---

## 1. Automated C Header Generation (`.h`)
When building a shared or static library with `sorayunara build --lib`, the compiler automatically generates a matching C header file:

```c
/* sorayunara.h - Auto-generated by Sorayunara Toolchain */
#ifndef SORAYUNARA_H
#define SORAYUNARA_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

int64_t sorayunara_compute(int64_t a, int64_t b);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif
```
